title: Parent-union recovery
mechanism: Select a diverse union of archived parents to recover complementary retrieval.
minimum_slice: Deterministic selector; at most seven parents; 63 candidates; target-free freeze.
metric: Real retrieval and exact tasks per verifier call
falsifier: V3 retrieval is not recovered and efficiency does not improve
promotion_gate: Non-inferior retrieval and at least two incremental real tasks

title: Operation-conditioned edits
mechanism: Allocate typed color and enum edits from parent AST and residual signatures.
minimum_slice: Typed edit policy with held-out scoring
promotion_gate: Two incremental real tasks without call inflation

title: Anti-unified parent schemas
mechanism: Anti-unify exact demonstration programs then instantiate supported fields.

title: Residual relational signatures
mechanism: Encode object adjacency, symmetry, connectivity and roles for repair routing.

title: Counterexample-directed repair
mechanism: Use smallest verified disagreement to select a bounded typed repair.
minimum_slice: Repair loop capped at two edits
promotion_gate: 25 percent call reduction at matched yield

title: Lossless typed codec
mechanism: Preserve dimensions, colors, objects and argument types within prompt limits.

title: Information-gain router
mechanism: Route by expected verifier information gain while preserving niches.
metric: Yield per call and niche coverage

title: Correlation-aware attempt two
mechanism: Choose attempt two by marginal causal coverage and ancestry distance.

title: Bounded typed composition
mechanism: Compose verified transformations when interfaces and dimensions match.

title: Scene graph latent decomposition
mechanism: Infer objects and relations before grid edits.

title: Provenance-gated training mix
mechanism: Prevent synthetic gains from masking real regressions with provenance-aware stopping.
minimum_slice: Balanced schedule and real-proxy early stop
metric: Real exact yield at matched calls

title: Fail-closed telemetry gate
mechanism: Reject non-finite JSON before publication and preserve original hashes.
minimum_slice: Streaming schema validator and hash manifest
